subtopics.content: 1.1 - 1.5 Meaning, assets/liabilities, business transactions, accounts, source documents
subtopics.objective: Understand definition, history, importance, career opportunities, values of bookkeepers, assets vs liabilities classification, business transaction parties, personal vs impersonal accounts, and identification/uses of source documents.

subtopics.content: Accounting concepts and conventions
subtopics.objective: Define, identify, and distinguish basic accounting concepts and conventions.

subtopics.content: Purpose, types, format, and preparation of prime entry books
subtopics.objective: Define, format, and prepare books of original entry including sales, purchases, returns, and general journals.

topics.title: Ledger and Principles of Double Entry

subtopics.content: 4.1 - 4.2 Ledger classification and double entry rules
subtopics.objective: Define, classify, format, and prepare ledgers. Understand the history, rules, and posting mechanisms of double entry bookkeeping.

subtopics.content: 5.1 Types and preparation of cash books
subtopics.objective: Understand, differentiate, and prepare single column, double column, three column, and petty cash books.

subtopics.content: Bank reconciliation purpose, terminologies, and discrepancies
subtopics.objective: Identify causes of differences between cash book and bank statement balances and prepare bank reconciliation statements.

subtopics.content: Trial balance rules, error classification, and suspense accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand functions and rules for preparing trial balances; classify errors, correct errors via journals, and open/balance Suspense Accounts.

subtopics.content: 8.1 - 8.3 Trading, Profit and Loss Account, and Balance Sheet
subtopics.objective: Prepare Trading Accounts (with stock valuation methods FIFO/LIFO), Profit and Loss Accounts, and simple Balance Sheets for sole proprietors.

subtopics.content: 9.1 - 9.2 Prepayments, accruals, bad debts, and depreciation methods
subtopics.objective: Calculate and account for prepayments, accruals, bad/doubtful debts, and depreciation using straight line and reducing balance methods.

subtopics.content: Sales Ledger and Purchases Ledger Control Accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand the purpose of and prepare Sales Ledger Control Accounts and Purchases Ledger Control Accounts.

subtopics.content: Conversion of incomplete records to final accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand limitations of single entry systems and prepare complete final accounts from incomplete business records.

subtopics.content: Receipts/Payments and Income/Expenditure Accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand content and prepare Receipts and Payments Accounts and Income and Expenditure Accounts for non-profits.

subtopics.content: Production cost calculation and final manufacturing accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand cost concepts (direct/indirect costs, prime cost) and prepare Manufacturing, Trading, and Profit and Loss Accounts.

subtopics.content: Deeds, capital/current accounts, appropriation, and partner admission
subtopics.objective: Account for drawings, interest on capital/drawings, prepare Capital/Current Accounts, Profit and Loss Appropriation Accounts, Balance Sheets, partner admissions, and Goodwill Accounts.

subtopics.content: Joint venture vs partnership, preparation of accounts
subtopics.objective: Understand joint venture concepts, distinguish them from partnerships, and record joint venture transactions.

subtopics.content: Preparation of departmental and branch records
subtopics.objective: Differentiate departmental and branch structures, and prepare Departmental Accounts and simple Branch Accounts.

subtopics.content: Formation, capital structure terminologies, and financial statements
subtopics.objective: Understand company formation, share capital terminologies, and prepare simple company financial statements.

subtopics.content: Financial ratio computations
subtopics.objective: Compute and interpret key ratios: Net Profit Margin, Gross Profit Margin, Stock Turnover, Quick Ratio, Acid Test Ratio, and Return on Capital Employed (ROCE).

subtopics.content: Accounting for business acquisition and sale
subtopics.objective: Understand terminologies and prepare accounting entries related to buying and selling existing businesses.

subtopics.content: Consignor and consignee records
subtopics.objective: Understand consignment terminologies and prepare simple Consignment Accounts.

subtopics.content: Seller and hirer book entries
subtopics.objective: Understand hire purchase principles and prepare appropriate ledger accounts in both hirer and seller books.

subtopics.content: Contract costing, work-in-progress, and profit recognition
subtopics.objective: Understand contract terminologies (retention money, architect certificates) and prepare Contract Accounts.

subtopics.content: Cooperative society objectives and financial records
subtopics.objective: Understand the meaning, core objectives, and basic accounting practices of cooperative societies.
